EllipticKTheory.title: Elliptic curves, Part II: scheme K-theory and arithmetic symbol classes
EllipticKTheory.reason: Make the existing Part II introduction and dependency precise: Elliptic curves is the first roadmap prerequisite. Its equation/function-field arithmetic, points, isogenies, divisors and torsion are imported, not rebuilt. Also import the existing Modular Curves scheme/Picard package and Algebraic Curves dictionary. New work starts with their K-theory-ready comparison, the origin-dependent K0 assembly, curve K1--K3, finite-curve computations, arithmetic integral images and certified symbols; analytic regulators remain with EllipticRegulators.

KTheoryLowDegrees.title: Grothendieck groups, Cartan maps, and Euler forms, Part II: explicit ring and curve K₀ and stable-matrix K₁
KTheoryLowDegrees.reason: Make GrothendieckEulerForms the first roadmap prerequisite, as the present introduction already intends. Start beyond its ordinary categorical K0, finite resolutions, Cartan and Euler-form constructions: projective/idempotent presentations, locally constant virtual rank, determinant/Steinitz, regular curves, explicit stable matrix K1, arithmetic SK1 and map-level higher comparisons. Do not delay early Z.1/U.1 behind higher K-theory or repeat the existing categorical groups.

SchemeKTheoryOperations.reason: Keep the independent general scheme/perfect-complex theory: enhancement, categorical K-theory, ring degree-zero operations and intersection theory are inputs, while scheme K/G maps, supports, descent, coniveau, projective/blow-up formulas, higher operations and their geometric comparisons are its residual subject. It is neither an elliptic special-case roadmap nor a replacement for GrothendieckEulerForms. No existing roadmap or live atlas file changes in this proposal.

EllipticKTheory:E.1.keeps: Assemble the imported elliptic scheme, affine Weierstrass ring and function field as three distinct inputs to the same scheme K-functor. Prove compatibility of the imported point/group-law and arbitrary nonzero isogeny dictionaries with the carriers actually used here; transport degree, separability, kernels, divisor pullback and invariant differentials. Include the zero scheme morphism separately (it has no function-field embedding). Retain every smooth/proper/geometrically connected/regular/chart assertion as an imported theorem and a comparison test, not a new construction.
EllipticKTheory:E.1.reason: Modular Curves owns the projective model, points/group law and scheme isogenies; its 2A bridge is only the multiplication-map comparison. Algebraic Curves 12 owns the broad function-field/isogeny dictionary. E.1 now owns the K-theory integration of those exact interfaces, including zero, not rival constructions.

EllipticKTheory:E.2.keeps: Assemble the origin-dependent group equivalence K0(E) ≃ Z ⊕ Z ⊕ E(F), transport the actual tensor multiplication (not the product-ring multiplication), and prove compatibility of point/line-bundle classes, degree, Euler characteristic and base pushforward. Compare function-field divisor classes with actual line bundles over F through the imported dictionaries. Retain rational-origin and descent-obstruction hypotheses; this stage is the unique owner of the elliptic K0 specialization formerly repeated in Z.5.
EllipticKTheory:E.2.reason: Z.5 owns general regular-curve rank/determinant and point classes; Jacobian A--B owns the line-bundle/cohomology language; Modular Curves 2D owns relative elliptic Picard duality. Existing Tau Ceti supplies the function-field degree-zero point equivalence and abstract degree splitting. Their scheme/K0 comparison and elliptic assembly remain here.

EllipticKTheory:E.3.keeps: Specialize and compare the full map-level closed-point localization segment from K3(X) through K0(X), including every intervening residue-field group, exactness, open/finite naturality, norms and ramification multiplicities. Prove the tame-kernel is the restriction image, number-field rational injectivity using torsion residue K2 and finite-field integral injectivity using vanishing residue K2. Preserve all non-rational closed points, rational versus integral lifts and sign tests.
EllipticKTheory:E.3.reason: Import the support/localization construction and symbol boundary comparison. E.3 owns the displayed curve segment and its arithmetic injectivity consequences, not a second localization theorem. The hypotheses proving residue-field torsion/vanishing remain explicit source obligations.

EllipticKTheory:E.4.keeps: Own the constant-unit image and splitting, curve SK1 as the tame-boundary cokernel, and the actual two-column curve K3 filtration/extension with its left K4-to-residue-K3 cokernel term. Compare its maps to E.3. Specialize imported Adams and motivic comparisons with actual eigenspaces/subquotients, finite coefficients and base-change maps, retaining the distinction from ring SK1 and from field indecomposable K3.
EllipticKTheory:E.4.reason: Ordinary codimension coniveau is S.4; higher operations are S.6; homotopy-coniveau layer-to-cycle identification and motivic convergence/degeneration are M.6a/b. These are related but distinct constructions. E.4 does not rebuild either global spectral sequence or discard its curve filtration term.

EllipticKTheory:E.5.keeps: Compare the imported pullback, proper-perfect pushforward and finite-flat transfer on the elliptic carriers. Compute the isogeny pull-push action by [f_*O], retaining its determinant/Picard contribution and proving any rational/special degree simplification. Specialize S.5's all-degree P1 formula and compare Z.6's degree-zero bases. Own the finite elliptic-curve K-group theorem, including finite generation/cohomology/Frobenius inputs, K1 ≃ Fq× ⊕ Fq× and the precise finite positive-degree prime-to-characteristic conclusions.
EllipticKTheory:E.5.reason: Generic maps/projection are S.2; projective bundles are S.5; the explicit two-basis K0(P1) check is Z.6. The isogeny computation and finite-curve theorem are not consequences of the field calculation alone and remain E.5 work.

EllipticKTheory:E.6.keeps: Construct and compare global regular proper flat models over O_F and O_{F,S}, supplying the gluing/global-existence and common-modification theorems not supplied by the local DVR contracts. Retain charts, vertical components/intersections via imported local geometry. Own full-base and S-integral rational K2 images, their model independence, vertical-residue/codimension-two characterization and bad-fibre tests. Prove any lattice assertion separately; neither a Neron model nor an unresolved singular Weierstrass scheme replaces the required proper regular model.
EllipticKTheory:E.6.reason: StableReduction owns its DVR blowups, resolution, regular/minimal-model geometry and local intersection theory; S.3/S.5 own K-theory localization/blowups. Global arithmetic-base geometry beyond those hypotheses and the integral-image theorem remain here; no unrestricted resolution or model-independence black box is introduced.

EllipticKTheory:E.7.keeps: Own finite-support horizontal/vertical tame certificates on actual functions, local leading units, Bloch Proposition 10.1.1 constant-symbol corrections, classes S_a and independence modulo torsion/constants. Consume existing torsion-divisor functions where applicable, prove any additional linear-system/normalization facts needed for the explicit construction, and transport them through E.1/E.2. Retain non-rational torsion via finite extension, transfer/norm/descent diagrams and E.3 rational lifts; analytic regulator formulas remain with ER.
EllipticKTheory:E.7.reason: Existence of functions for n(P)-n(O) is already supplied by the elliptic divisor/Weil-pairing owner and pinned Tau Ceti. Reusing it does not supply Bloch's corrections, full finite certificates, vertical integrality or descent; all those remain here.

EllipticKTheory:E.8.reason: Retain the completion gate and all three worked tests: nontrivial symbol, non-rational closed point and bad-fibre integrality. No universal number-field K-group classification or finite-generation assertion is added.

KTheoryLowDegrees:Z.1.reason: GrothendieckEulerForms owns ordinary exact/split K0 and the categorical Cartan setting. Its finite-dimensional Morita case is imported and compared; the general ring-level explicit extension remains here and precedes K.2:plus/K.7. Complements use existing module theorems, not a new higher-K axiom.

KTheoryLowDegrees:Z.2.keeps: Own virtual integer-valued rank on Spec from existing natural-valued stalk rank, finite image, localization/base change, disconnected and finite-product comparison, ring K0 over fields/division rings via dimension, and local/semilocal ring-level consequences with explicit component hypotheses. Reuse categorical finite-dimensional K0 and available local finite-flat freeness; retain F × F ≃ Z² and division-ring tests.
KTheoryLowDegrees:Z.2.reason: The vector-space categorical dimension calculation already belongs upstream; transporting it to ring K0 is new here. Mathlib stalk-rank locality is an implementation input, not evidence that the virtual K0 homomorphism or all product/semilocal comparisons already exist.

KTheoryLowDegrees:Z.3.reason: Own the early commutative-ring K0 tensor/exterior-power/virtual lambda identities, componentwise determinant to Pic, augmentation kernel and algebraic gamma-filtration relation. KTheoryLowDegrees:Z.4.reason: Retain Steinitz, I⊕J ≃ A⊕IJ, the inverse rank/Pic comparison with zero separately, S-localized class-group quotient and extension/localization/transfer formulas including the determinant of the algebra. KTheoryLowDegrees:Z.5.keeps: Own the general connected regular noetherian curve rank-determinant isomorphism, with its actual finiteness/resolution hypotheses, vector-bundle realization of K0, structure/sheaf/skyscraper/divisor class formulas and compatibility with the K/G and divisor-to-line-bundle dictionaries. The general theorem has no dependency on elliptic Picard specialization. Export its result to E.2; the origin-dependent elliptic K0 expression is owned only by E.2. On smooth proper curves reuse the Jacobian dictionary, and on regular projective function-field models reuse Algebraic Curves 12; any additional dictionary/resolution argument for a general regular noetherian (possibly nonproper or arithmetic) curve remains a named part of this stage, not an application outside those suppliers' hypotheses.

Preserve the non-rational-origin counterexample gate. The suppliers' smooth/proper or regular-projective restrictions do not shrink the retained general-curve target.

KTheoryLowDegrees:Z.6.reason: Generic K/G Cartan is S.2 over the existing categorical Cartan, projective bundles are S.5, and the elliptic rank/Pic specialization is E.2. Z.6 owns comparison and tests, not another proof of those general constructions.
